general.notes: Power budget 0–2.0 dB (optical, w/o path penalties). Power consumption stated as < 1.5 W. Typical reach: 70 m @ OM3, 100 m @ OM4. Transmitter OMA output power Min -4.5 dBm, Max +3.0 dBm; receiver sensitivity OMA -6.5 dBm at 53.125 Gbps (50GE) and BER 2.4E-4. Footnote 1): average receive power (min) is informative; below min cannot be compliant. Footnote 2): at 53.125 Gbps (50GE) and BER 2.4E-4. FEC required to be implemented by the host. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Transmit max output printed as +4.0Bm (dBm implied).
general.suggestions: Consider reach_m alongside reach_km when datasheets quote meters only. OMA min/max TX and RX OMA sensitivity are standard for 50GBASE-SR but not in schema as separate fields.
